root_cause.text: The ixp46x_ptp_find() function was called unconditionally in the time stamping (PTP) paths without checking whether the platform actually supports PTP (i.e., is an ixp46x), resulting in a NULL pointer dereference when attempting to access PTP clock resources on non-ixp46x hardware.
